label: Whatever causes a thing's being r contains r, formally or eminently, partial causes included
paraphrase: Analyst strengthening of the Cartesian containment clause, not attributed: for every cause c of x's being r (CAUSE_2, partial causes included) where x is in act in r, c is itself in act in r, with the mode of possession, formal or eminent, left open (IN_ACT_4). Respect-wise: it constrains only the perfection caused, not every perfection of the effect. Open.
